title: Godrej HIT Codebase
description: Comprehensive reference document for the Godrej HIT product line.

products.name: Kala HIT
products.description: Aerosol spray designed to eliminate mosquitoes and flying insects.
products.features: Reaches deep corners to kill hidden mosquitoes, providing protection against Dengue and Malaria vectors.

products.name: Lal HIT
products.description: Aerosol spray designed to eradicate cockroaches and other crawling insects.
products.features: Features a deep reach nozzle for cracks and crevices to kill cockroaches hiding in corners.

products.name: HIT Anti Roach Gel
products.description: Hassle-free, long-lasting pest control gel for cockroaches.
products.features: Odorless application, kills the entire nest of cockroaches, providing long-lasting control without fumes.

products.name: HIT Chalk
products.description: Chalk line repellent to keep homes free of ants, cockroaches, and other crawling insects.
products.features: Simply draw a line across floors or surfaces; crawling insects are killed upon crossing the toxic chalk line.

products.name: HIT Rat Solutions
products.features: Glue pads offer a non-toxic solution to capture rats indoors safely. Rat Cubes serve as effective baits for rodent management.

products.name: HIT Mosquito Racquet
products.features: Intelligently designed unique shape to reach corners, larger coverage area, offering active protection from disease-carrying mosquitoes.
